oga: [ava+gaha+tvā] (gva)yha (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) To descend. (B) To enter. (C) To get or attain.
ogacchanti: [ava + gamu + a + anti] (kri) CL=7 (1) They reach a state of cessation. They sunset. See - Ogacchati (B). (2) They reached a state of exhaustion. See - Ogacchati (2).
ogacchanta: [ava + gamu + anta] (pu, na) CL=7 (A) One who sinks down. (B) (Sun) set.
ogacchati: [ava+gamu+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) (A) He descends. (1) He reaches cessation. (Sun) set. (2) He reaches exhaustion.
ogadha: [ava + gādha + hi] (kri) CL=7 May (you) establish or set up.

[ava+gādha+a. ] (ti) CL=7 [Gādha patiṭṭhāyaṃ. Ogādhatīti ogadhaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 742. Avagāḍha (saṃ)] (1) (Nibbāna) that is a support (place). A cause of supporting that is (Ariyāmagga). (3) Inside or within. Includes (in). Enters and establishes.
ogaha: [ava+gaha+a+hi] (kri) CL=7 May you go deep (into) or may you descend. See - Ogahati (A).
ogahaṇa: [ava+gaha+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Bathing port. (2) False belief or wrong view.
ogahissati: [ava + gaha + ssasi] (kri) CL=7 (Someone) will enter. See - Ogahati (B).
ogali: [ava+gala(gaḷa)+tvā] (ḷi)tvā (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) To run downwards. (B) To slope down.
ogamana: [ava + gamu + yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Ceasing (to exist). Entering. (2) (A period) of entering. (3) Dissolution.
ogantvā: [ava + gantvā. ] (kri, vi) CL=7 [Ava+gamu+tvā] Having descended or sunk.
ogata: [u+gata] (ti) CL=7 Emerges or comes to perceive or attains enlightenment.
ogaḷitvā: [ava+gaḷa+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having run downwards. See - Ogali(ḷi)tvā (A).
ogaṇa: [ava+gaṇa. ] (ti) CL=7 [Avaṇa (saṃ)] (1) A less sect. One who lacks attendants. (2) One who has a less group member. One who is without an attendant.
oggata: [ata+gamu+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Gone down or descended. (2) Free from.
oggatatta: [oggata+atta] (ti) CL=7 One who lacks a mind. A dead person.
oggayha: [ava+gaha+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 To go down or to go deep into, To enter. See - Oga(gga)yha (B).
ogha: [ava+hana+ra. ] (pu) CL=7 [Avayavaṃ katvā byapiyati gacchatīti ogho. Dhāna, ṭī. 629. Ava+hana+kvi. Ohaññati ete-nāti ogho. Moga,5.100.ava+hana+ra. Kaccaññaḥ, sutta. 538. Uca+ghaña. U-cyate o‌gho. Cintāmaṇi,ṭī.15,39. Uca + ṇa. Vi, pi,dhāna. Ava+hara+ra.vibhāvinī. Ogha (saṃ)] (1) Water stream. (A) Water course or current. (B) The stream of water that overflows the top of the bank. (2) Many (dhamma). (3) A collection or set. (4) The dhamma that causes to sunk living beings in the cyclic suffering. Ogha dhamma. (5) The dhamma that can not cross over. (6) An ocean that is saṃsarā. Saṃsarā ogha. (7) A pile or a lump.
[ogha + ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) With water stream. (River, ocean) where has wide and deep water streams. (2) The dhamma is like a water stream. (A) Four factors of Ogha. (B) Kilesā.
oghagocchaka: [ogha+gocchaka] (pu) CL=7 A group of duka that are connected as the flower garland (by the meaning of) ogha dhamma. Oghagocchaka.
oghana: [(1) ava+hana+yu. ] (na) CL=7 (2) Ava+ghana] (1) Causes to sink living beings in the cyclic suffering. (2) A pile that is a cause of pulling down. A pile that is hanging down.
oghanadī: [ogha + nadī] (thī) CL=7 A river that has water streams.
oghandhakāra: [ogha + andhakāra] (pu) CL=7 The pitch-black darkness that is four factors of ogha. See - Oghatamaga.
oghani: [oghana + ṇika (iya). ] (nī)ya (ti) CL=7 [Avahananaṃ oghanaṃ, oghanena niyuttā oghaniyā. Bhāsā, ṭī. Ogha + anīya. Madhu.] (1) Should be overcome (by concentration) four factors of ogha. The sense object of four factors of ogha. (2) Causes to sink and afflict.
oghanittharaṇa: [ogha + nittharaṇa] (thi, na) CL=7 Overcomes four factors of ogha.
oghanittharaṇattha: [oghanittharaṇa + attha] (pu) CL=7 The benefit that is liberation from four factors of ogha.
oghaniyaogha: [oghaniya + ogha] (pu) CL=7 Ogha dhamma that causes to sink and afflict.
oghanta: [ogha + anta] (pu, na) CL=7 The end of four factors of ogha. See - Ogatamaga.
oghapatha: [ogha + patha] (pu) CL=7 The path or road that is covered with water streams.
oghapauhasutta: An ascetic seeker named Jambukhādaka who asks Venerable Sāriputtarā about as well the ogha dhamma, as well the practice of giving up this ogha dhamma, so he preaches the eight magga dhamma that is a cause of giving up this ogha. See - Saṃ, 2. 452.
oghapuṇṇa: [ogha + puṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 Filled with water streams.
oghapāsa: [ogha + pāsa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Kilesā stream. Kilesā trap. (2) Four factors of ogha. Rāga trap.
oghasampayutta: [ogha + sampayutta] (ti) CL=7 Yoking with four factors of ogha.
oghasaṃsīdana: [ogha+saṃsīdana] (ti) CL=7 Sinking in four factors of ogha.
oghatama: [ogha + tama] (pu) CL=7 The pitch-black darkness that is four factors of ogha.
oghatamaga: [oghatama + aga] (ti)  CL=7 One who overcomes pitch-black darkness which is four factors of ogha.
oghatara: [ogha + tara] (ti) CL=7 One who has overcome four factors of ogha.
oghataraṇa: [ogha + taraṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Oghataraṇa sutta. (2) The practice of overcoming the four factors of ogha. (3) Overcoming the four factors of ogha.
oghataraṇamukha: [oghataraṇa + mukha] (na) CL=7 Makes first and foremost overcoming the four factors of ogha.
oghataraṇapaṭipatti: [oghataraṇa + paṭipatti] (thī) CL=7 The practice of overcoming the four factors of ogha. See below.
oghataraṇākāra: [oghataraṇa + ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The manner of overcoming four factors of ogha.
oghataraṇūpāya: [oghataraṇa + upāya] (pu) CL=7 The practice that overcomes four factors of ogha.
oghatikka: [ogha + tiṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who has overcome four factors of ogha.
oghatiṇṇamukha: [oghatiṇṇa + mukha] (na) CL=7 Makes first and foremost overcoming four factors of ogha.
oghavana: [ogha + vana] (na) CL=7 A forest full of (trees).
oghavepulla: [ogha + vepulla] (na) CL=7 Development of four factors of ogha.
oghavippayutta: [ogha + vippayutta] (ti) CL=7 Not yoking with four factors of ogha.
oghaṭṭha: [ogha + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of that is difficult to cross over or overcome. Meaning of ogha.
oghuttaranupāya: [oghuttarana + upāya] (pu) CL=7 The method or way of overcoming four factors of ogha.
oghuttaraṇa: [ogha + uttaraṇa(na)] (na) (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is swimming without fear in water streams (which are mixed with crocodiles or in which has crocodiles). (prañña, say.) (2) Which is a cause of overcoming four factors of ogha.
oghātaka: [yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Oghātaka.
oghātiga: [ogha + atiga. ] (ti) CL=7 [Ogha + ati + gamu + kvi] One who overcomes four factors of ogha.
ogilikā:
[ava+gila+ṇvu+ā (itthīpaccaññaḥ)] (thī) CL=7 The question that should be swallowed down.
(Although one who sees the offense or deficiency in the question, it is not suitable to remove this offense so should swallow down this question).
ogilitukāma: [ogilituṃ + kamu + ṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who wants to vomit.
ogilituṃ: [u + gila + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To vomit. See below.
oguha: [yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 A snake is named Oguha.
ogumphetvā: [ava+guphi+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having gone away. (ṭṭha.) Having destroyed. (ṭī.).
ogumphiyati: [ava + guphi + ya + te. ] (kamma, kri) CL=7 [Dhātvattha.101.] Should be wrapped in all directions. Ties. (Wraps and ties the wall of the dwelling place).
oguṇṭhana: [ava+guṭhi+yu. ] (na) CL=7 [Dhātvattha. 98] Wrapping on the head. Covering the head.
oguṇṭhi: [ava+guṭhi+i] (thī) CL=7 Wrapping on the head. Covering the head.
oguṇṭhika: [oguṇṭhi+ka.] (ti) CL=7 [Oguṇṭha+ika] One who wraps the head. Covers the head. See below.
oguṇṭhita: [ava+gaṭhi+ta] (na) CL=7 (1) Wrapping around the head. Covering around the head. (Ti) (2) Should be covered around the head. (pācita, yo.) Wrapping around the head. (kaṅkhā, mahāṭī.) One who covers around the head. (kri, vi) Covering together the head. (3) Covers all. (4) Should be smeared. Mixed and smeared.
oguṇṭhitasīsa: [oguṇṭhita+sīsa] (ti) CL=7 With the head wrapped. Wrapped together the head. One who covers around the head.
oguṇṭhitvā: [ata+guṭhi+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having wrapped in all directions. Having worn. Having covered.
ogvacchati: [ava+gamu+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 Goes deep into or descends. Low down.
ogādha: [ava + gādha + a(ṇa).]  CL=9 Atagāḍha (saṃ)] (a) entering upon. (2) inside; To enter inside and stand; Being the support; Familiarity. (3) Support (Nibbāna). (4) Support (Noble Magga).
ogādhanti: [ava + gādha + anti] (kri) CL=7 They establish. See - Ogadha 2 (1)(2).
ogādhapatta: [ogādha + patta]  CL=9 (1) one who enters upon. (2) one who stands after entering inside, one who has reached  the support- familiarity (in terms of familiarity that exists among each other).
ogāha: [ava + gaha (gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + ṇa.] (na) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha]. (A) Bathing port. (2) Descends. Goes down. (3) Enters into. (4) Enters by the power of intimacy. Familiar or acquaintance.
[ava+gaha+(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + a + hi ] (kri) CL=7 May you descend or may you go deep into. See - Ogahati.
ogāhana: [ava+gaha(gāha.gāhu.gāhū) + yu. ] (na) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha]. (A) A period of descending. (B) A period of entering.
ogāhanakkhama: [ogāhana + khama] (ti) CL=7 Suitable for going deep (into). Suitable for descent.
ogāhanaṭṭha: [ogāhana + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of entering (into).
ogāhanta: [ava + gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + anta. ] (ti) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha. In thi ogāhantī.] (A) One who enters. (B) Descends or goes deep (into). (C) Runs downwards.
ogāhanti: [ata+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+a+anti] (kri) CL=7 They enter. They enter and take. See - Ogāhati (B).
ogāhanākāra: [ogāhana + ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The manner of entering.
ogāhappatta: [ogāha + patta] (ti) CL=7 One who reaches a state of absorption by the power of intimacy. See also - Ogādhapatta(2).
ogāhasi: [ava + gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+si] (kri) CL=7 (A) You descend or go deep (into). (B) You enter (into). You enter and take. See - Ogāhati (A) (B).
ogāhati: [ava+gaha+(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + a+ ti. ] (kri) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha]. (A) He descends or goes deep (into). (B) He enters. He enters and takes.
ogāhayanti: [ava + gaha + ṇaya + anti] (kri) CL=7 They enter and take.
ogāhayi: [ava + gaha (gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + ī] (kri) CL=7 (He) entered. He entered and took. See - Ogāhati (B).
ogāhaṇa: [ava + gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + yu] (na) CL=7 Toxic that is a wrong doctrine or wrong view. See - Otaraṇa (3).
ogāhe: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+eyyāmi] (kri) CL=7 He will go deep into or will descend. See - Ogāhati (A).
ogāhetabba: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be entered. See below.
ogāhetabbaṭṭha: [ogāhetabba+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning that should be entered.
ogāhetvā: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (1) Having held firmly. Having immersed (in). (2) (A) Having gone deep (into) or having descended. (B) Having entered.
ogāhetvāna: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+tvāna] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having entered.
ogāhissati: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+ssati] (kri) CL=7 He will go deep into or will descend. See - Ogāhati (A).
ogāhita: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+ta.] (ti) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha]. One who enters and absorbs.
ogāhitabba: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + tabba] (ti) CL=7 (A) Should be descended or gone deep into. (B) One who should be entered and taken.
ogāhituṃ: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+tuṃ.] (bya) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha]. (A) To enter. (B) To insight by wisdom.
ogāhitvā: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) Having descended into or having gone deep into. (B) Having entered.
ogāhiṃ: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + ī] (kri) CL=7 I entered into. See - Ogāhati (A).
ogāhāpenti: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+ṇāpe+anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They cause to take. See - Okkāmenti.
ogāhī: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+ṇa+ī (itthī paccaññaḥ] (thī) CL=7 Bathing pool. See - Ogāha 1.
ogāḷha: [ava+gaha+ta. ] (ti) CL=7 [(See - ogāhetvā. Ava+gāhu (gāhū) + ta. Rū. 621. Dhātvatthasaṅgaha. 96. Ava+gāha+ta. Moga, 5. 148(sya). Moga, 7. 223. Avagāḍha (saṃ)] (1) (A) Should be entered. (B) Should be penetrated. (2) Immersed. (3) Inclusive, (4) (A) Entered into or absorbed into, (5) Enters and contemplates.
ogāḷhacitta: [ogāḷha + citta] (ti) CL=7 One who has an absorbed mind.
ogāḷhamicchattaniyāma: [ogāḷha + micchattaniyāma]  CL=9 One who has certainty (in terms of yielding/getting result immediately after death) having been the wrong nature that is descended- entered upon. See okkantaniyāma.
ogāḷhañāṇa: [ ogāḷha + ñāṇa ] (na) CL=7 Absorbed and contemplated wisdom.
oghasasīdana: [ogha+saṃsīdana] (ti) CL=7 Sinking in four factors of ogha.
ogilitu: [u + gila + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To vomit. See below.
ogāhitu: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū)+tuṃ.] (bya) CL=7 [See - Ogāḷha]. (A) To enter. (B) To insight by wisdom.
ogāhi: [ava+gaha(gāha. Gāhu. Gāhū) + ī] (kri) CL=7 I entered into. See - Ogāhati (A).
